construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored within the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Object with schema_version=1, synthetic=true, research, documents, guided
shared_schema.research_configuration: allowed_hosts: exact lowercase DNS hosts; urls: unique HTTPS URLs; fixtures: URL -> {content_type, body}
shared_schema.document_configuration: fields: [{name, source, type, required=true, default?, transforms=[]}]; checks: [{field, op, value?}]
shared_schema.guided_configuration: steps: [{id, title, requires=[], checks=[]}]; completed_steps: unique step IDs
shared_schema.record: {id: unique string, data: nonempty scalar-valued object, provenance: {url, sha256, record_index, retrieval: synthetic_fixture}}
shared_schema.validation: Shared object, array, scalar, string, provenance and record validators; shared check specification and execution used by documents and onboarding
shared_schema.success: {schema_version: 1, synthetic: true, status: ok, research: {sources, findings}, documents: {fields, rows, checks_passed}, guided: {steps, progress}}
shared_schema.error: {status: error, error: message}; exit code 2; one JSON object on stdout

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated findings with source URL, exact-content SHA-256 and zero-based record index
Validated transformed rows and declared field names; prerequisites inspect these rows; each step carries record IDs and unchanged provenance

behavior.retrieval: Offline exact-URL synthetic fixture adapter; no network fallback, redirects, providers, or hidden reads
behavior.ingestion: HTTPS-only exact-host allowlist; reject URL credentials, fragments, nonstandard ports, whitespace, backslashes and IP-literal allowlist entries
behavior.extraction: JSON arrays of nonempty flat scalar-valued objects, or text/plain key=value records separated by blank lines
behavior.automation: Configurable key selection/renaming, string/integer/finite-number/boolean conversion, missing-key defaults, nullable optional fields, string strip/lower/upper/title transforms
behavior.checks: nonempty, type-strict equals, numeric min/max, full-match regex, type-sensitive unique; document failures stop pipeline
behavior.onboarding: Acyclic prerequisite graph evaluated topologically; completed/ready/blocked states; requested completion rejected when blocked; all-row checks; completed count, total and fraction
behavior.determinism: Input order and content-derived provenance preserved; no clock, randomness, mutation of caller input or persistence side effects
behavior.bounds: 50 URLs, 1000 aggregate records, 100000 characters per fixture body, 200-character regex patterns

excluded: Persistent user state; progress is supplied and returned as JSON

cli_example.stdout: One JSON object with status ok

test_outcomes.error_contract: Missing files, invalid argument counts, invalid JSON/schema and invalid encoding return a single JSON error object and exit 2
